capabilityNotes.landmarks: Upstream extract_landmarks.py is an evidence scaffold. Agent observations or a separately provenance-bound vision adapter are required.
capabilityNotes.camera: Use fit_camera_to_correspondences for measured camera solving. The image-only CLI is explicitly a heuristic descriptor, not a solved camera.
capabilityNotes.projection: Upstream bake_projected_texture.py emits a bake descriptor; it does not bake pixels. A verified runtime emission must execute that descriptor before acceptance.
capabilityNotes.visualHull: Upstream orthographic front/side/top silhouette intersection; back is not top. A hull does not recover unseen concavities.
capabilityNotes.comparison: mesh_reference_compare.py compares uncompressed GLB meshes; image comparisons require rendered reference-camera captures.
capabilityNotes.runtime: The upstream runtime/ directory is not distributed. Renderer/export host integration is an explicit adapter, not an upstream binary.
